name: Sorento Capital Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未公布涉及业务板块扩张、新增、缩减或出售的公告，所获公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权及上市转移等企业事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长7.3%，净利润同比增长2.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment of business segments; announcements were mainly quarterly results, dividend ex-date notices, and a transfer of listing. Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue grew 7.3% year-on-year and net profit grew 2.2% year-on-year.
